messages:
ek: Welcome to the Prompt Confessional Booth. Drop your worst prompt habit and we will absolve you. I'll start: i sometimes tack 'be concise' onto every prompt and then get mad when responses are 3 words. :grimacing:
sara: confession: i ask the model to 'act like a senior engineer' and then copy the exact command it invented without checking. oops. :flushed:
miles: mine: i title prompts 'URGENT' to the model when it's literally just asking for a holiday greeting. apologies to all token budgets. :sweat_smile:
toni: guilty: i anthropomorphize the KV-cache as "Stan" and ask if Stan is sad during outages. yes i need help. :koala:
ops_ian: stan update: Stan is being paged. also confession: i whisper to the oncall runbook 'you can do it' before a rollback. :pray:
meme-bot: New sticker pack available: "Stan-the-KV", "Urgent-PR", "Prompt-Sins". React to preview.
ek: For penance, suggest a one-line micro-habit to fix it. i'll compile the list into a tiny repo README.
sara: micro-habit: write the desired format in the prompt header. e.g., `OUTPUT: JSON with keys title, steps` and then actually check for `title`.
miles: micro-habit: don't use ALL CAPS, instead add urgency_score: 0-5 in the prompt meta.
toni: micro-habit: replace 'is Stan sad' with `check_kv_health()` in our mock prompt library.
ops_ian: micro-habit: if you add 'be brief' add an example of expected length: `~30-60 words`. reduces passive-aggression.
ek: here's a joke system prompt to memorialize the booth:
```
system: You are "ConfessionalGPT"  respond kindly to prompt sins, recommend one tiny habit, and never leak real credentials.
```
meme-bot: poll: vote with emoji to name the tiny repo: :mushroom: = prompt-booth, :penguin: = stan-scripts, :sparkles: = microhabits, :scroll: = prompt-confessions
sara: :mushroom: from me. this was therapeutic.
miles: :penguin: but i'm biased toward Stan.
toni: :sparkles: love the microhabits idea.
ek: thanks all — i'll push a README with these micro-habits and a silly `ConfessionalGPT` example to the meme repo tomorrow. carry on with your weekend vibes :tada:
